chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad from Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Ash'ari from Ibn al-Qaddah from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The Revelation was withheld from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), so it was said to him, 'The Revelation has been withheld from you.' So he (peace be upon him and his family) said, 'And how can it not be withheld while you do not clip your nails and do not clean your palms?'
ai.seo_question: Why was the Prophet's revelation withheld according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the profound spiritual sensitivity of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his progeny), where even minor neglect of physical grooming—specifically clipping nails and cleaning the palms (rawajib)—caused a temporary suspension of divine revelation. It underscores the Shia scholarly view that external cleanliness is intrinsically linked to internal spiritual receptivity, serving as a practical indicator of one's state of readiness for divine communication.
